word_translation_en: to worry, to care, to look after, to ensure
sentence_example_translation_en: I will take care of the dinner.
sentence_synonym: Ich kümmere mich um das Abendessen.
typical_collocations: für jemanden sorgen; sich Sorgen machen; für Ruhe sorgen
usage_comments_en: Often used with the preposition 'für' (+ accusative) meaning 'to take care of' or 'to ensure'. When used as a reflexive verb ('sich sorgen um' + accusative), it means 'to worry about'. Do not confuse with 'sich kümmern um', which is very close but 'sorgen für' can also mean providing financial support or ensuring a state (e.g., 'für Ordnung sorgen').

word_translation_en: to get, to obtain, to purchase, to take care of
sentence_example: Kannst du bitte die Kinokarten besorgen?
sentence_example_translation_en: Can you please get the cinema tickets?
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ты не мог бы достать билеты в кино?
sentence_synonym: Kannst du bitte die Kinokarten beschaffen?
typical_collocations: Fahrkarten besorgen; Einkäufe besorgen; ein Geschenk besorgen
usage_comments_en: Commonly used in everyday language for getting or buying something. It can also mean to take care of a task (e.g., 'etwas besorgen'). In passive or adjective forms like 'besorgt', it means 'worried'.

word_translation_en: to dispose of, to throw away, to waste-manage
sentence_example: Wir müssen den alten Kühlschrank umweltgerecht entsorgen.
sentence_example_translation_en: We must dispose of the old refrigerator in an environmentally friendly way.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы должны утилизировать старый холодильник экологически безопасным способом.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen den alten Kühlschrank umweltgerecht beseitigen.
typical_collocations: Müll entsorgen; Abfälle entsorgen; fachgerecht entsorgen
usage_comments_en: Specifically used for waste, garbage, toxic materials, or large items. It implies proper, legal, and often ecological disposal, unlike the simple 'wegwerfen' (to throw away).

sentence_example: Mach dir keine Sorgen um mich.
sentence_synonym: Mach dir keinen Kummer wegen mir.
typical_collocations: sich Sorgen machen; in Sorge sein; finanzielle Sorgen
usage_comments_en: Noun, feminine. Usually used in the plural 'Sorgen' for troubles or worries. The singular 'Fürsorge' means care or welfare. Note the common idiom 'sich (dative) Sorgen machen um (accusative)'.

sentence_example: Sie bewahrt die alten Briefe in einer sorgsamen Weise auf.
sentence_example_translation_en: She keeps the old letters in a careful manner.
sentence_synonym: Sie bewahrt die alten Briefe in einer behutsamen Weise auf.
typical_collocations: sorgsamer Umgang; sorgsam auswählen; sorgsam umgehen mit
usage_comments_en: An adjective describing a gentle, protective, and attentive way of handling things or people. Similar to 'sorgfältig' (which is more about precision and accuracy, e.g., work/homework) and 'behutsam' (gentle physical touch).

word_translation_en: to care for, to look after attentively, to nurse
word_translation_ru: окружать заботой, заботиться со всех сторон
sentence_example: Die Großmutter wurde von ihrer Familie liebevoll umsorgt.
sentence_example_translation_en: The grandmother was lovingly cared for by her family.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Семья с любовью заботилась о бабушке.
sentence_synonym: Die Großmutter wurde von ihrer Familie liebevoll gepflegt.
typical_collocations: liebevoll umsorgt; rührend umsorgen; jemanden pflegen und umsorgen
usage_comments_en: A highly caring verb, often used in the passive. It implies extensive, affectionate attention, ensuring someone has everything they need. It has a more emotional and nurturing connotation than 'pflegen' or 'betreuen'.

word_translation_en: to supply, to provide, to cater to, to treat (medical)
sentence_example_translation_en: The hospital treats the injured people.
typical_collocations: mit Strom versorgen; eine Wunde versorgen; die Familie versorgen
usage_comments_en: Governs the preposition 'mit' (+ dative) for the supplied goods: 'jemanden mit etwas versorgen' (to supply someone with something). Can also mean caring for a medical wound or providing livelihood for a family.

sentence_example: Der Vater sah sich lange Zeit als der alleinige Versorger der Familie.
sentence_example_translation_en: For a long time, the father saw himself as the sole breadwinner of the family.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Отец долгое время считал себя единственным кормильцем семьи.
sentence_synonym: Der Vater sah sich lange Zeit als der alleinige Ernährer der Familie.
typical_collocations: medizinischer Versorger; lokaler Energieversorger; alleiniger Versorger
usage_comments_en: Noun, masculine. Can refer to utility companies (e.g., 'Energieversorger' - energy provider) or to a person who provides financial support for others ('Ernährer').

sentence_example: Die medizinische Versorgung im Land ist hervorragend.
sentence_example_translation_en: Medical care in the country is excellent.
sentence_synonym: Die medizinische Betreuung im Land ist hervorragend.
typical_collocations: ärztliche Versorgung; Versorgung mit Wasser; staatliche Versorgung
usage_comments_en: Noun, feminine. Abstract noun of 'versorgen'. Used frequently in compounds like 'Energieversorgung', 'Wasserversorgung', 'Wundversorgung'.

word_translation_en: to make provisions, to take precautions, to plan ahead
word_translation_ru: принимать меры предосторожности, запасаться заранее, заботиться о будущем
sentence_example: Man sollte für das Alter vorsorgen.
sentence_example_translation_en: One should make provisions for old age.
sentence_synonym: Man sollte für das Alter Vorsorge treffen.
typical_collocations: für schlechte Zeiten vorsorgen; fürs Alter vorsorgen; finanziell vorsorgen
usage_comments_en: Separable verb ('sorgt vor'). Usually implies taking financial, health, or logistical steps now to prevent problems or secure wellbeing in the future. Often used with the preposition 'für' (+ accusative).
